units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>בשעת נְטִיעָתָן</he> when you plant them.
<cite ref="Berakhot 35a:18">Ber. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>בר נ׳</he> that which belongs to the vegetable Kingdom.
Snh. 68ᵃ נְטִיעַת קישואין planting of cucumbers; a. fr.—Esp. young tree, shoot.

<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:4">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ מקטע וכ׳</he> the law concerning young trees (<cite ref="P01387"><he>עָרְלָה</he></cite>) cuts off the feet of the butchers (ought to teach them patience, so as not to use meat before flaying and dissecting).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:8">Shebi. I, 8</cite> <he>נ׳ כשמה</he> by ‘a young plant’ (with reference to the Sabbatical year law) we understand what its name indicates (during the first year). Y. ib. 33ᵇ bot. <he>נ׳ מעין עשר</he> as to young shoots the proportion of ten to a field of a S’ah’s size is required, v. infra; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְטִיעוֹת</he>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>כחן של נ׳ וכ׳</he> the endurance of young plants and the beauty &c., v. <cite ref="G00299"><he>זִיו</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:6">Shebi. I, 6</cite> <he>עשר נ׳ מפוזרות וכ׳</he> if ten young trees are scattered over a field of one S’ah’s size, we may plough the entire field for their sake (on the eve of the Sabbatical year); <cite ref="Sukkah 34a:2">Succ. 34ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עשר נ׳</he> the law concerning young trees in a field &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 5b:12">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>יהי רצון שכל נ׳ שנוטעין וכ׳</he> may all shoots taken from thee be like thyself.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:1:6">Y. Yeb. I, 2ᵇ</cite> <he>חמש נ׳ נטע</he> he planted five shoots, had five sons; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:9">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>קיצץ בנ׳</he> he mutilated the shoots (of the garden of religion, v. <cite ref="Q01590"><he>פַּרְדֵּס</he></cite>), i.e. became irreligious, v. <cite ref="S01836"><he>קָצַץ</he></cite>.—Mekh. B’shall., Shir. s. 10, v. <cite ref="N01377"><he>נְתִיצָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: pitching a tent, putting up a temporary structure.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 5b:13">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="A01676"><he>אַכְוַרְנְקָא</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="N00575"><he>נָטַע</he></cite>.
